command:
set +e
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
set -uo pipefail
cd /tmp
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp MPLCONFIGDIR=/tmp/mpl
printf '79ef557c6f22e86bf28808ecc22707cc460b09a18b0fbadde21793c3d6fbffa2  fetch.py\n97811d33f5548f127b002c4d98d4855aaeb3b0e58aacdd938eb6251da0b07a9c  inspect_release.py\n' > scripts.sha256
sha256sum -c scripts.sha256 || { echo 'FAIL: a staged script does not match its pin'; exit 1; }
mkdir -p /tmp/out /tmp/log
python3 -u fetch.py /tmp/out 2>&1 | tee /tmp/log/fetch.log
grep -q 'FETCH OK' /tmp/log/fetch.log || { echo 'FAIL: fetch'; exit 1; }
python3 -u inspect_release.py /tmp/out/IGWN-GWTC2p1-v2-GW150914_095045_PEDataRelease_mixed_nocosmo.h5 > /tmp/log/inspect.txt 2>&1
tail -3 /tmp/log/inspect.txt
ls -l /tmp/out
echo DONE
